dbo.User_Mst: App users/members: profile, mobile, name, city, area, status. Central table most others link to.
dbo.User_RefreshToken: Login refresh tokens issued to users (security data).
dbo.user_session: Active login sessions per user device, app version, expiry, revoked flag.
dbo.OTP_Request: One-time-password requests sent to mobile numbers for login/verification.
dbo.Admin_UserMst: Back-office admin users and their roles.
dbo.City_Mst: Master list of cities, belongs to a state, with latitude and longitude.
dbo.m_area: Master list of areas / localities and pincodes inside a city.
dbo.News_Category_Mst: News categories such as sports, politics, local.
dbo.News_Post: News posts: headline, body, status, category, city, area, author user, created date.
dbo.News_Media: Images and videos attached to a news post.
dbo.News_Like: Likes given by users to news posts.
dbo.News_Comment: Comments written by users on news posts.
dbo.Reel_Post: Short video reels posted by users: caption, video, duration, city, counts.
dbo.Reel_Likes: Likes given by users to reels.
dbo.Reel_Comment: Comments written by users on reels.
dbo.Reel_View: Reel view events with watched seconds per user.
dbo.Post_Notification: Notifications sent to users (likes, comments, system), with read flag.
dbo.Report_Reason_mst: Master list of reasons used when users report content.
dbo.Add_Plan_Mst: Advertising plans/packages: price, duration days, radius km, placement, max creatives.
dbo.Ad_Price: Ad price list by duration and scope, amount in paise.
dbo.Advertisements_Post: Advertisements created by advertisers (users): plan, title, CTA, target city, status. Newer ad table linked to plans, media, events and orders.
dbo.Ad_Media: Images and videos of an advertisement (linked to Advertisements_Post).
dbo.Ad_Post: Older/simple ad posts by users with city, area, image, link, linked to Payment_Txn.
dbo.Event_Ad: Ad impression and click events (event_type, placement) per advertisement.
dbo.Order_Payment: Orders/payments for buying an ad plan: amount, gateway, status.
dbo.Order_Invoice: GST invoices for orders: base amount, IGST, SGST, CGST, invoice number.
dbo.Payment_Txn: Payment transactions for ads in paise: base, tax, total amount, gateway status.
